## Part C: expected-value credit vs realised difference rewards (non-shared IPPO)

Episodes to 90% greedy test success (first crossing; censored at budget).

| K | arm | n | episodes to 90% (mean) | per seed | censored |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | team | 5 | 21734 | [48000, 2650, 48000, 7130, 2890] | 2 |
| 4 | expected | 5 | 6714 | [4330, 4010, 11210, 10170, 3850] | 0 |
| 4 | difference | 5 | 1802 | [1770, 1450, 1450, 1370, 2970] | 0 |
| 8 | team | 5 | 36506 | [54810, 28570, 27290, 36250, 35610] | 0 |
| 8 | expected | 5 | 8506 | [8890, 9210, 8890, 9370, 6170] | 0 |
| 8 | difference | 5 | 1338 | [1290, 1450, 1370, 1290, 1290] | 0 |

| K | ratio | ratio of means | geometric mean of per-seed ratios | per seed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | expected / team | 0.309 | 0.571 | {10: 0.09, 11: 1.513, 12: 0.234, 13: 1.426, 14: 1.332} |
| 4 | difference / expected | 0.268 | 0.288 | {10: 0.409, 11: 0.362, 12: 0.129, 13: 0.135, 14: 0.771} |
| 4 | difference / team | 0.083 | 0.164 | {10: 0.037, 11: 0.547, 12: 0.03, 13: 0.192, 14: 1.028} |
| 8 | expected / team | 0.233 | 0.238 | {10: 0.162, 11: 0.322, 12: 0.326, 13: 0.258, 14: 0.173} |
| 8 | difference / expected | 0.157 | 0.159 | {10: 0.145, 11: 0.157, 12: 0.154, 13: 0.138, 14: 0.209} |
| 8 | difference / team | 0.037 | 0.038 | {10: 0.024, 11: 0.051, 12: 0.05, 13: 0.036, 14: 0.036} |

- **C1** (K = 8, expected/team > 0.5 (expected credit is not >2x faster); paired one-sided t-test on log ratios): geometric mean ratio 0.238, p = 0.9962 -> **NOT SUPPORTED**
- **C2** (K = 8, difference/expected < 0.2; paired one-sided t-test on log ratios): geometric mean ratio 0.159, p = 0.0169 -> **SUPPORTED**
- **C3** (K = 8, difference/team < 0.2; paired one-sided t-test on log ratios): geometric mean ratio 0.038, p = 0.0001 -> **SUPPORTED**
- **C4** (K = 4): descriptive, table above.
